title: Bambu Lab X2D Combo $1098, P2S Combo $948, P1S Combo $678 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Retravision
body:
Deal: Bambu Lab X2D Combo $1098, P2S Combo $948, P1S Combo $678 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Retravision

[stickyfingers] Any chance of a price beat at OW? I have a bunch of gift cards to use.
[stickyfingers] Eh bugger it, bought through here. You can find an RAC member number if you Google Images search for one btw.
[Josephluppino] I called Officeworks and did a price beat for Retravision on the A1 Combo - came down to $549.10
[prelude] Good price, although the P2S and X2D are on back order
This product is not in stock and is required to be ordered in from the supplier. Lead times vary depending on the supplier and model, and once you have placed your order Retravision will contact you within 24 hours with an estimated delivery timeframe. Please proceed if you are happy to continue with your order.
[Orrelljet] For $678 the P1S AMS (1) Combo is an absolute steal. Mine is still doing everything I want it to and a second at this price is super tempting.
[tm32] Typically the A1 would be the start point , but at that price go straight to the P1S deal. Cracking price.
[Pipersaurus] Paid almost twice that for mine! Great price.
[Jamie777] They will drop a multi-tool heads printer today. See that first.
[3dprintdeals] it wil lbe 1am tonight our time.
And H3C will be a completely different price point to A/P/X series.
[3dprintdeals] The discount will be automatically applied in the cart. No coupon required.
[dreamzz] P1s or x2d? Only $360 difference very tempting
[dreamzz] Sorry P1S Combo original AMS $644.10 vs X2D Combo with AMS2 Pro $1,038.10
Difference $394.00. With rac discount.
[3dprintdeals] They are in different leagues. (AMS 1 vs AMS 2, 1 vs 2 nozzles, Heated chamber & filtration etc)
It's more like P2S vs X2D
P2S Combo - $852.37 (add cheap item to get over $1000 threshold)
X2D Combo - $1038.10
$185 difference, go the X2D for the dual nozzle.
Unless you don't want to spend that much, go the P1S Combo
[bleugh] wow, X2D is a no-brainer at this price.
absoloutley perfect for single colour 'engineering' stuff that needs supports.
with their own support material as the interface layer, this printer will give you superb prints quickly
you can use support material on the P1 series also, BUT, a single nozzle means a LOT of purging / waste so fine if it's not so often
I have a P1S (bought for $1250 18 months ago)…seriously considering the X2D….But, the H2 has a huge build plate, but. but
